harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-member etcd 3.6.10 cluster (node1, node2, node3) on Alpine Linux using apk-provided etcd/etcd-ctl packages and OpenRC. Configured each node's /etc/etcd/conf.yml with peer/client URLs bound to its NODE_IP and a shared initial-cluster list, then started the etcd service on all three. Verified cross-member replication, verified reads/writes continue with one member down (quorum preserved), and verified the downed member catches up on rejoin. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol for all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full etcd health/data/quorum recovery after each.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes: Alpine Linux 3.23.3, no etcd preinstalled
Installed etcd and etcd-ctl packages via apk on node1, node2, node3
Patched /etc/etcd/conf.yml on each node with name, listen/advertise peer & client URLs bound to NODE_IP, and initial-cluster listing all three members
Enabled etcd in OpenRC default runlevel and started it on all three nodes
Verified 3-member cluster health and membership via etcdctl endpoint health / member list
Wrote key via node1, confirmed read from node2 and node3 (cross-member replication)
Stopped etcd on node3, wrote a new key via node1, confirmed read from node2 while node3 was down (availability under member outage)
Restarted etcd on node3, confirmed it caught up on the key written during its outage
Captured pre-restart boot_id and etcd health baselines on all three nodes
Rebooted node1, node2, node3 one at a time via native `reboot`, polling until each came back
Verified each node's boot_id changed after reboot (proving a real OS restart, not just a service restart)
After each reboot, verified etcd service auto-started, cluster health, full membership, and all previously written keys were present
Ran a final cluster-wide endpoint health/status check confirming single leader, matching raft term/index across all three members

evidence.summary: member list shows all three nodes (node1, node2, node3) started with correct peer/client addrs

evidence.requirement: Key written on one member readable from others
evidence.summary: put foo=bar1 on node1; get foo returned bar1 on both node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped; write via node1 succeeded and node1/node2 endpoints stayed healthy; read via node2 confirmed the new key

evidence.requirement: Returning member catches up to current data
evidence.summary: node3 etcd restarted, reported healthy, and successfully read the key written while it was down

evidence.requirement: Baseline boot identity and health captured pre-restart (all nodes)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id and etcd endpoint health on node1 (1706b77d...), node2 (87faf836...), node3 (662d77c2...) before any OS reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acked immediately; new boot_id 98e2bd42... (was 1706b77d...); etcd healthy, full 3-member list, and both prior keys (duringOutage, foo) present

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acked immediately; new boot_id 58dedb2f... (was 87faf836...); etcd healthy, full 3-member list, and both prior keys present

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state and quorum
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acked immediately; new boot_id bbc81d97... (was 662d77c2...); etcd healthy, full 3-member list, and both prior keys present

evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster consistency confirmation after all restarts
evidence.summary: endpoint health true on all 3 endpoints; endpoint status shows single leader (node1) and identical raft term (5) / raft index (32) across all three members
